morphology.pattern_note: 外来专名，整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。正常书写首字母大写；所列IPA为英语读法示例，实际读音以姓名持有者为准。

senses.zh_definition: 科尼利厄斯：源自拉丁语的人名，通常用作男性名字，也可作姓氏。
senses.en_definition: A personal name of Latin origin, used as a masculine given name and as a surname.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang berasal daripada bahasa Latin, digunakan sebagai nama lelaki atau nama keluarga.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，不是具有普通词汇释义的马来语通名。马来语定义为编写说明，并非DBP原文。以下搭配是姓名的常见使用结构，不代表该姓名的搭配频率统计。原始资料未提供分音节和爪夷文，故保留null。[姓名来源说明](https://www.behindthename.com/name/cornelius)

etymology.historical_story: Cornelius began as the name of a Roman gens, or extended family, before becoming a personal name in later naming traditions. Christian usage helped carry it across languages. Its often-repeated connection with Latin cornu, meaning horn, is possible rather than certain. In Malay discourse, it identifies a person rather than conveying a literal horn-related meaning. [Onomastic reference](https://nvb.meertens.knaw.nl/verklaring/naam/Corn%C3%A9lis)
